name: Sin Eater adds 5 charges to Torchlight (#2201)
contract: Sin Eater 680542 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with one effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 4 = SPELLMOD_CHARGES, base 4 die 1 -> +5, SpellClassMask[0] 0x80000. Torchlight 503662 is family 21 with SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x80000, so the modifier applies to it. Its charge pool is the spell_proc row Charges = 5 in data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260907_15_witch_hunter_torchlight.sql, read by Aura::CalcMaxCharges, which passes it through ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CHARGES). The Description reads 'Increases the amount of next attacks that grant Flames of Sin through Torchlight by 5.' A control and a holder each cast Torchlight on their own dummy; the applied aura must hold 5 and 10 charges, and the native modifier query must give the same 5 -> 10. Whether the extra attacks then grant Flames of Sin is the existing Torchlight script's job and is not asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control: the charge modifier leaves Torchlight's 5 charges
Sin Eater adds 5 charges to Torchlight
With Sin Eater Torchlight starts with 10 charges
